heroHeadline: 'DtMF' Hits 60 Weeks at No. 1 — All-Time Hot Latin Songs Record Extended as European Tour Heads to Lisbon After Triumphant Barcelona Two-Night Run
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny's 'DtMF' has now spent 60 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs (chart dated May 23, 2026) — extending the all-time record it broke at week 57 by surpassing Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's 'Despacito.' The milestone arrives as Bad Bunny completes his sold-out two-night run at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (54,000 per night), where Spanish press dubbed the shows 'Spain's biggest tour of the year.' Night 2 (May 23) opened with 'BAILE INoLVIDABLE' with Catalan-Puerto Rican artist Bad Gyal making a surprise guest appearance on 'Yo Perreo Sola,' joining him on the roof of 'La Casita.' The DtMF World Tour now heads to Lisbon (May 26–27, Estádio da Luz) before a 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid beginning May 30 — the same day the Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) goes on wide release via the Adidas Confirmed app. The Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-piece collection continues to sell across 41 global markets following its midnight ET launch on May 21. The Porto Rico epic film (directed by Residente, co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production with principal photography expected late 2026.
